name: Hermite Data Computation via Bisection
definition: A method to find all edge crossings in an adaptive octree for an implicit function and compute Hermite data (intersection points and normals) using bisection.
summary: Hermite Data Computation via Bisection extracts precise intersection points and normals from adaptive octrees by iteratively refining linear guesses, ensuring sub-cell accuracy and sharp feature preservation unlike simpler linear estimates.
